riverwatch.name: Riverwatch Garrison
riverwatch.description: The soldiers and scouts who hold the river town of Riverwatch and, in theory, the roads around it. Short of men, long on paperwork, and slow to trust outsiders.

thornwood_free.name: The Thornwood Free
thornwood_free.description: The outlaws of the Thornwood: debtors, deserters, unlicensed mages and people the garrison forgot. They say the law is the real problem. Some of them have a point; some of them are just thieves.

river_compact.name: The River Compact
river_compact.description: The merchant league that runs the roads and rivers: tolls, barges, caravans, and the Riverlands' real government. Polite, patient, and owed money by everyone.

ashen_fields.name: The Ashen of the Fields
ashen_fields.description: The quiet grey villages of the Grieving Fields, led by their Listeners. They hear the wisps, mourn them, and trust outsiders about as far as the next cairn.

ilunar_empire.name: The Ilunar Empire
ilunar_empire.description: The crown, its legions and its nobles. Empress Corvina rules from the Hall of Spears in Ilunhall, and her Steward decides who gets near her.

lantern_order.name: The Lantern Order
lantern_order.description: Lantern-bearing inquisitors who hunt corrupt mages and burn essence-drinkers. Their chapterhouse stands on the Long Halls of Ilunhall.
